reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper and routes all five inline midpoint copies through it.

duplication.why: Removes five duplicated midpoint/dispatch expressions instead of editing each; no new duplication.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module the client and server already import for scheduled amounts.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, a unit test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One definition now governs every ranged-amount path, with comments updated and the test pinning both orders and signs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server sites now call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; the copies were removed.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client callers.
